headline: Steady dividend, stalling growth
chart_note: 52-week range: $137.62 - $167.25. Currently $146.53, well off the 52-week high and close to the low end of its range.
why_today: Fiscal Q4 organic sales were flat YoY and core operating margin fell 130 basis points, with core EPS down 3% - a soft quarter that explains why the stock is trading closer to its 52-week low than its high.
pro_1: One of the lowest-beta large caps in the market (0.38) - a genuine ballast holding in a volatile portfolio
pro_2: $2.8B in pre-tax productivity savings this year still funds brand investment despite margin pressure
con_1: Full-year organic sales growth of just 1%, with margins moving the wrong direction
con_2: Trading near 52-week lows is a signal the market isn't yet convinced the growth slowdown is temporary
